slides.title: Copy the SCEP details
slides.html: Copy the SCEP URL and the Challenge. Your MDM needs both. Keep the challenge to yourself: while enrolment is open, it is what lets a phone join.

slides.title: Prepare two Fleet teams
slides.html: Once per deployment, set up two teams with the same apps, policy and Deploy App icon: a preparation team without a certificate, and a Deploy App team whose certificate names each phone after its user. rmscep mdm-apply --team "Deploy App" --prep-team Preparation sets up both. The icon has to be the same one in both teams: a phone keeps the apps it enrolled with, and loses an icon the other team does not share.

slides.title: Phones without names
slides.html: If names do not matter, use a team whose certificate takes the phone's enrollment ID instead. Phones then join under that ID as soon as they enrol.
